executive_summary: Thirteenth consecutive week of failure with zero trades taken and zero P&L. The Supply & Demand Zone strategy is categorically broken — it has produced 0-1 trades per week for over three months across all regime types (trending_up, trending_down, ranging). The regime shifted from trending_down to trending_up mid-week and back again, yet no trades were generated in either direction, proving the strategy is non-functional regardless of market conditions. This system requires a complete architectural overhaul, not parameter tuning.
target_progress: 0% — 70% below 70% target. No meaningful progress in 13 weeks.
regime_assessment: Regime detection appears to be working — it correctly identified the shift from trending_down (W38 continuation) to trending_up mid-week and back to trending_down by Friday. However, this information is entirely wasted because the strategy generates zero signals in ANY regime. Regime detection is irrelevant when the core signal generator is dead.

param_search_adjustments.reasoning: After 13 weeks of near-zero trade generation, the current min_score=75 and rr_ratio=2.0 are catastrophically restrictive. However, simply lowering parameters within the same broken framework will likely just produce losing trades (as seen in W37-W38 when trades did occur). These ranges are provided only as a fallback if the structural recommendations below cannot be implemented.

structural_recommendations.change: REPLACE primary strategy: Abandon Supply & Demand Zones as the sole strategy. Implement a momentum/trend-following strategy (e.g., EMA crossover with ATR-based stops, or breakout of N-day high/low) as the PRIMARY signal generator. S&D zones can remain as a FILTER or confluence factor, not the entry trigger.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Increase from 0-1 trades/week to 10-20 trades/week. Even at 45% win rate with 1.5:1 RR, this produces positive expectancy vs current zero activity.

structural_recommendations.change: Implement a MINIMUM trade frequency circuit breaker: If zero trades are generated by Wednesday close, automatically reduce all filter thresholds by 30% for the remainder of the week. If still zero by Thursday close, switch to a simple mean-reversion or momentum strategy for Friday.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Eliminates zero-trade weeks entirely. Guarantees minimum 2-3 trades per week for data collection and strategy evaluation.

structural_recommendations.change: Add regime-specific strategy routing: trending_up → buy breakouts/pullbacks to rising EMAs; trending_down → sell rallies into resistance/short breakdowns; ranging → fade extremes at S&D zones. The current system uses ONE strategy for ALL regimes, which is architecturally flawed.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Expected to improve win rate by 10-15% by aligning entry logic with prevailing market structure instead of fighting it.

structural_recommendations.change: Run a one-time backtest audit on the S&D zone detection algorithm itself. Log all zones identified in the past 13 weeks and check: (a) are zones being detected at all? (b) is price reaching the zones? (c) are the score thresholds mathematically achievable with current zone construction? There may be a code bug causing zero zone qualification.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: May reveal a software defect that explains 13 weeks of near-zero activity. If found and fixed, could immediately restore functionality.

structural_recommendations.change: Decouple optimization from live trading: Run paper-trade simulations of 3-4 alternative strategies in parallel next week while the current system continues. Use the parallel data to select the best replacement strategy for W41.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Provides data-driven strategy selection within 1 week instead of continued blind iteration on a broken approach.
